text:
Rafael Gomez: Hi @Tina (People Ops) 11I need a temporary accommodation for a recurring flare-up of a chronic back condition. Requesting ergonomic equipment (upright chair and monitor arm) and 2 remote days/week for the next 8 weeks to manage physical therapy appointments. Prefer this be confidential.

Tina (People Ops): Thanks Rafael. We can certainly help. Quick check: do you want us to file an ADA intake or start with an informal accommodation request? Also will the 2 remote days be regular weekdays or flexible each week? :clipboard: 

Rafael Gomez: Please file ADA intake to have it on record. I'd like Mon+Thu remote consistently. I can provide a physio note. Worried this will affect my promotion packet in June.

Chris L. (Eng Manager): Rafael, thanks for raising this. I'm fine with Mon/Thu remote and will work with the team on async planning. We won't block your promotion for using accommodations but let Tina confirm how we should document this for calibration.

Tina (People Ops): Filing intake now: https://intra.redwood/hr/ada-request. Case ID HR-2026-317. We'll limit visibility to People Ops and your manager. For equipment, we can route an order to IT Support and mark delivery as "private equipment request".

Rafael Gomez: Thanks. Also need a short-term workload adjustment for sprint demos the first two weeks while I start PT. Can we reassign presenter duties those days?

Chris L. (Eng Manager): I can swap presenters for the next two sprints. We can also mark your tasks as low priority for those days. Rafael, DM me the list and I'll reassign.

IT Support: Got it. We'll submit an ergonomic equipment order (height-adjustable chair, monitor arm). ETA 7-10 business days. Shipping address will use your default office desk. If you prefer pick-up or different location, tell us.

Rafael Gomez: Pick-up at reception is fine. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tina (People Ops): Case HR-2026-317 updated: ADA intake received, provider note attached. Remote-days approved Mon/Thu for 8 weeks. Equipment order placed. We'll add a neutral note for calibration clarifying schedule exceptions without medical details, so review committees aren't confused.

Rafael Gomez: That helps a lot. Will requesting this show up in my calibration packet explicitly? I just want to make sure nothing gets misinterpreted.

Tina (People Ops): It won't include medical details. We'll add a simple admin note: "Approved temporary schedule accommodation (Mon/Thu remote) during recovery period." If you'd like, we can also add a manager comment noting coverage arrangements so it doesn't reflect on availability.

Chris L. (Eng Manager): I'll add a short note about coverage and swapped presentation duties. No impact on promotion timeline from my side.

hrbot: [Automated] Accommodation case HR-2026-317 logged for Rafael Gomez. People Ops will follow up within 2 business days.

Rafael Gomez: Thanks everyone. I submitted the provider note and confirmed pickup. Really appreciate the support. :heart:
